news.title: Evicted 87-year-old Spanish pensioner to return home after deal
news.summary: An 87-year-old Madrid pensioner whose eviction became a rallying point for Spain’s housing protests will be able to return home after reaching a deal with the property’s owners, her lawyer said Monday. The agreement comes as demonstrations across the country pile pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s government to address soaring rents, a shortage of affordable homes and weak tenant protections.
news.source: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
